newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes little changed.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes little changed.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Tuesday closed little changed in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 617.87 from 617.49 on Monday.
Trade volume was 1.304 million dinars against 411,692 dinars.
Airliner Tunis Air was up by 2.01 percent to 16.2 dinars. Banque de Tunisie was down by 2.22 percent to 81.2 dinars. ($=0.96 dinar)
